text:
Marine Works - Chaleur - Miscou - south
Construction of rock berm in Escuminac Harbour, New Brunswick in position 47 04.867N 064 53.083W. Area of work will be contained by a silt curtain. The top of the silt curtain will be yellow and visible above the water surface. Yellow cautionary buoys will also be installed with light and radar reflectors spaced at 30m minimum and 100m maximum intervals.
                                                    Cancels NW-M-0916-26
